title: Whose Values, Which Contexts, and What Signals? Grounding Cultural Value Alignment with Re3Culture
abstract: arXiv:2610.41793v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cultural value alignment requires not only model optimization but also a well-specified target grounded in real-human evidence. Yet how such targets should be grounded in human data remains largely unexplored, raising three fundamental questions: (1) whose values should be represented? (2) where should cultural values be observed? and (3) what signals reveal underlying values? We investigate these questions through Re3Culture, a large-scale dataset linking (i) Representative communities: 700+ human participants across four cultures recruited through cultural-affiliation screening and demographic-aware sampling; (ii) Realistic scenario: culturally sensitive scenarios selected by community members, e.g., family and kinship; and (iii) Revealed value signals: 1,400+ value surveys, 20,000+ topic-grounded behavioral principles and explicit value priorities with responses for 6,000+ situated questions. translated_title: 谁的价值、何种情境、什么信号？基于Re3Culture的文化价值对齐研究
translated_abstract: 文化价值对齐不仅需要模型优化，还需要一个基于真实人类证据的明确目标。然而，这些目标应如何扎根于人类数据在很大程度上仍未被探索，由此引出三个基本问题：(1) 应该代表谁的价值？(2) 应该在哪些情境中观察文化价值？(3) 什么信号能够揭示潜在的价值？我们通过Re3Culture数据集来研究这些问题，这是一个大规模数据集，将三个方面联系在一起：(i) 代表性社区：通过文化归属筛选和人口统计学感知抽样招募的来自四种文化的700多名人类参与者；(ii) 现实情境：由社区成员选择的文化敏感情境，例如家庭与亲属关系；(iii) 显现的价值信号：1,400多份价值调查、20,000多条基于主题的行为原则，以及针对6,000多个情境化问题的明确价值优先级及其响应。我们的分析展示了为什么这些选择至关重
tldr: 提出Re3Culture大规模数据集，从代表性社区、现实情境和显现价值信号三个维度出发，为模型的文化价值对齐提供了基于真实人类证据的目标基础。
en_tdlr: Re3Culture is a large-scale dataset that grounds cultural value alignment in real human evidence by linking representative communities, realistic scenarios, and revealed value signals.
